title: Sr Ops Lead Customer Partner

title: Strategic Finance Associate/Sr. Associate - Product
description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a Strategic Finance Associate / Sr. Associate to join our growing Strategic Finance team, with a focus on Product finance. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders to shape the financial strategy of our business. You will build and maintain financial models, develop KPI frameworks, and deliver insights that influence product investments and growth priorities.

You'll also be a core finance partner on Zip's AI strategy, from how we price and package to how we forecast AI revenue and the inference costs that come with it.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you'll play a critical part in connecting product strategy with financial outcomes, supporting long-range planning, and influencing decisions at the executive and board level.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design and manage the financial models that support our annual plan, long-range forecast, and multi-product growth strategy

- Partner with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders to set topline targets, evaluate roadmap investments, and align on strategic priorities across the business

- Model the financial impact of Zip's AI products and decisions, including pricing scenarios, unit economics, gross margin, and investment cases for new capabilities

- Create and maintain KPI frameworks that track product performance and sales efficiency, giving leadership a holistic view of the business to guide resource allocation

- Support executive decision-making by preparing high-quality board materials, investor updates, and leadership presentations

- Drive company-wide forecasting and reporting processes across revenue, expenses, headcount, cash flow, and retention metrics

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 2+ years of private equity, investment banking, or similar experience

- Experience in strategic finance at a high-growth technology company is a plus

- Familiarity with technology, SaaS, and usage-based business models

- Excellent financial modeling and quantitative skills

- Extreme attention to detail with a high regard for precision

- Strong written and verbal communication

- Ownership mindset with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams and stakeholders

The salary range for this role is $128,000-$184,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Graubünden
description:

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

title: Contact Center Systems Engineer
description:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Contact Center Systems Engineer to support a large-scale, global enterprise contact center environment.
This role combines production support and platform engineering , including contact center routing, telephony troubleshooting, Linux-based systems, integrations, and migration from an existing commercial platform to a next-generation platform built on open-source telephony technologies.
Key Responsibilities

• Configure and maintain routing strategies, queues, IVR flows, and agent targeting across voice, chat, email, and task channels

• Troubleshoot production issues across telephony, network, and application layers

• Diagnose voice quality issues including latency, jitter, packet loss, codecs, and media-path problems

• Troubleshoot SIP/VoIP call flows and routing logic

• Support number provisioning, porting, and regional routing

• Analyze existing contact center configurations and map them to a new platform architecture

• Build and validate configurations in Linux environments

• Support platform migration and feature-parity testing

• Integrate systems using REST APIs and webhooks

• Participate in production incident triage and resolution

• Create technical documentation, runbooks, and structured shift handovers

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise Contact Center platforms

• Experience with Genesys, NICE, Five9, Avaya, Cisco , or similar platforms

• Strong knowledge of SIP, RTP, and VoIP

• Experience troubleshooting call flows, routing logic, and media-path issues

• Networking knowledge including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and QoS

• Strong Linux skills including service configuration, log analysis, and command-line troubleshooting

• Scripting/programming experience with Python, JavaScript, or Bash

• Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, Git, and deployment workflows

• Experience supporting and troubleshooting production systems

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, OpenSIPS, Asterisk , or similar open-source telephony technologies

• Contact center platform migration experience

• Experience with Wireshark, sngrep, sipgrep, or HOMER

• Terraform or Ansible

• Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Datadog

• SQL fundamentals

• Cyara or other automated voice-testing platforms

• Exposure to AI-enabled contact center capabilities such as virtual agents, intent-based routing, or speech analytics

• ITIL / ITSM familiarity

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: RMF / Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist (Pipeline)
description:
About Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC

At Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC , we deliver secure, innovative solutions in support of national defense and intelligence missions. As a trusted government contracting partner, we provide top-tier intelligence and technology services that safeguard our nation. Our team is mission-driven, and we are committed to building careers that matter.

Location: This is a US-based remote position.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Security Clearance: No security clearance required. Minimum active Tier 1 (or higher) federal background investigation required prior to start; ability to obtain a CAC if required by duties.

Join Our Pipeline for Future Opportunities!

This posting is intended to establish a pool of qualified candidates for future openings supporting ongoing operations. Positions may become available based on staffing needs, operational requirements, or workforce changes. Qualified applicants may be contacted as opportunities arise.

Job Summary

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking an RMF / Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist to support the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Walla Walla Business Intelligence (WWBI) program. This role owns cybersecurity compliance, Risk Management Framework (RMF) documentation, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and authorization artifacts, working closely with software developers, DevSecOps personnel, technical leadership, and Government stakeholders to ensure WWBI continuously complies with applicable Department of Defense (DoD), U.S. Army, USACE, and Civil Works Business Intelligence (CWBI) cybersecurity requirements. This position also supports maintenance of the WWBI authorization package and the program's planned migration into the CWBI Cloud and eventual integration into the CWBI security boundary.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, update, and maintain WWBI Risk Management Framework authorization documentation, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP), Incident Response Plan (IRP), System Design Documents, and related authorization artifacts.

• Manage and document program-specific security controls applicable to the WWBI system, and support security requirements associated with Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

• Maintain documentation defining the WWBI authorization boundary, including applicable hardware, software, ports, protocols, interfaces, and data flows.

• Coordinate cybersecurity documentation and compliance activities associated with WWBI's migration into the CWBI Cloud and eventual incorporation into the CWBI authorization boundary.

• Maintain WWBI compliance records within the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS), including uploading, mapping, organizing, and maintaining required RMF documentation, security-control evidence, implementation statements, and supporting artifacts.

• Support execution of the WWBI continuous-monitoring program, including coordinating and/or performing required ACAS and SCAP security scans, and maintaining a compliance score of at least 90% for applicable SCAP scans.

• Import and maintain security-scan results within DISA STIG Viewer and eMASS; analyze identified vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation activities with software developers and Government technical personnel.

• Track Critical and High findings for immediate remediation, Moderate findings for remediation within 60 days, and Low findings for remediation within 120 days; document approved exceptions and outstanding findings within the Plan of Actions and Milestones (POA&M).

• Develop, maintain, and submit the quarterly POA&M report detailing open, remediated, and outstanding security findings, and support quarterly updates to the RMF documentation package.

• Provide ACAS/SCAP scan results and associated STIG Viewer files following required scans, and maintain current system security, network topology, logical, and data-flow documentation in coordination

title: Sr. Director, Regulatory Affairs
description:
About Artiva
We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies. Our mission is to develop effective, safe, and accessible cell therapies for patients with devastating autoimmune diseases. We aim to develop therapies that patients and physicians can utilize in a community setting. Our lead product candidate, AlloNK®, is a non-genetically modified, cryopreserved NK cell therapy being evaluated in combination with B-cell targeted monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). We believe the compelling cell-killing properties of NK cells, when combined with mAbs for targeting, create an opportunity to generate potentially transformative therapies.
For more information, visit
Join Artiva Biotherapeutics in San Diego and work directly on the manufacturing floor to produce our innovative, off-the-shelf cell therapies in a state-of-the-art cGMP facility. Apply your expertise across cell culture, aseptic processing, harvest and fill-finish, playing a direct role in advancing therapies for patients with autoimmune diseases.
For more information, visit .
Job Summary:
The Senior Director of Regulatory Affairs is responsible for primary authorship and supporting regulatory activities, preparing regulatory submissions and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cell and gene-modified cell therapy, expertise in global regulatory requirements, and preferably late-stage development experience.
Duties/Responsibilities:

• Support the preparation, review, and submission of regulatory filings, including INDs, CTAs, BLAs, and MAAs, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.

• Assist in compiling and organizing regulatory documents and responding to health authority queries.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Clinical, Pharmacovigilance, Biometrics, and CMC, to ensure accurate and complete regulatory submissions.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of global regulatory requirements and contribute to regulatory intelligence efforts.

• Support regulatory interactions with global health authorities by preparing meeting materials and responses to requests.

• Contribute to the development of regulatory documentation, including CTD dossiers, IBs, clinical protocols, nonclinical and clinical study reports.

• Assist in tracking regulatory commitments and timelines to ensure timely submissions and approvals.

• Provide hands-on support in assessing emergent clinical data and operational activities for regulatory compliance.

• Demonstrated experience developing algorithms for sensing technologies, measurement systems, medical devices, or related disciplines.

• Experience analyzing large and complex datasets with multiple signals and dependencies.

• Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced technical environments.

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.
The Role
As a Consultant in our Quality Practice , you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.
Our Quality Practice supports global Operations teams in delivering safe and effective products efficiently to more patients. We focus on Quality process and operating model improvement spanning Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and Training across Pharma, MedTech, and Consumer products. Our team is growing rapidly. As a Consultant, you will own business process, change management, and/or program management workstreams of transformational programs spanning software, AI agent, and business process redesign.
What You'll Do

•
Lead project workstreams from end-to-end, ensuring the high-quality design and delivery of customer solutions

•
Solve complex problems for Life Sciences leaders, leveraging Veeva’s unique data and software insights

•
Mentor and manage Associate Consultants, overseeing their work and professional development within your workstream

•
Drive practice growth by contributing to business development and internal IP creation

Requirements

•
Experience: 3+ years in Life Sciences Consulting (Business or Management Consulting preferred)

•
Domain Knowledge: Proven expertise in Quality, Manufacturing, and/or Supply Chain

•
Analytical Rigor: A strong mindset for both quantitative and qualitative reasoning

•
Communication: Ability to articulate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher

•
Not a perfect match yet? If you have 3-5 years of life sciences experience, a recent advanced degree, or a military background, Master Class is your pathway to a consulting career. [ Explore Master Class ]

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of Veeva products

• Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

• Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

• Retirement programs

• 1% charitable giving program

• Unrivaled career progression in a fast-growing, global team

• Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation

title: Sr Service Delivery Analyst
description:
At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.
All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.
As a Senior Service Delivery Analyst, you'll play a key role across revenue cycle operations, analytics, and client delivery. You'll use deep revenue cycle knowledge, Epic Clarity expertise, and advanced SQL to turn complex operational data into accurate, client-ready insights - partnering with Customer Operations, Central Operations, and client stakeholders to surface trends, uncover defects, and drive action. This is not a traditional reporting role; you'll operate independently, make credible recommendations, and help shape how analytics support operational and client success.

What you'll do

• Build, optimize, and maintain reporting and analytics solutions supporting Customer Operations and Service Delivery priorities

• Use advanced SQL and data modeling to extract, transform, and validate data from complex revenue cycle environments

• Apply Epic Clarity and revenue cycle knowledge to identify trends, defects, and process improvement opportunities

• Translate analysis into clear, client-ready reporting and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences

• Conduct account and performance reviews that surface actionable opportunities

• Perform rigorous QA on metrics and reports to ensure accuracy and credibility

• Own follow-up actions and drive execution against recommendations - not just analysis

• Serve as a trusted analytics partner to internal teams and client counterparts

• Contribute thought leadership and mentorship to grow the broader analytics function

What we're looking for

• 8+ years of professional experience, with strong background in revenue cycle and analytics-driven roles

• Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations (billing, claims, denials, A/R, payment posting)

• Hands-on experience with the Epic Clarity data model, ideally in Resolute/Hospital Billing

• Advanced SQL skills - complex joins, aggregations, transformations, and scalable query design

• Experience with Snowflake, relational databases, and reporting tools such as Power BI

• Proven ability to turn messy operational data into reliable, decision-ready insights

• Track record presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders and/or clients

• Strong attention to detail, independent judgment, and ability to manage multiple priorities

Preferred qualifications

• Epic Resolute Hospital Billing certification

• Data modeling experience in Snowflake

• Familiarity with stored procedures / T-SQL

• Prior client-facing analytics or service delivery experience

• Experience mentoring analysts or building team capabilities

What success looks like

•
First 30 days: Ramp up on R1's data environment, reporting ecosystem, revenue cycle workflows, and existing reporting logic. Establish trust through accurate outputs and responsiveness.

•
By 90 days: Independently own meaningful deliverables, produce client-ready reporting with minimal oversight, identify trends that drive operational value, and serve as a trusted partner to internal and client stakeholders.

title: Ingénieure ou Ingénieur de recherche et développement en Physico-chimie

title: Product Manager (LATAM)
description:
We're hiring a Product Manager for to join a globally distributed product and engineering team. The job is to turn business priorities into work engineers can pick up and ship, then stay with it through release.
This is hands on and execution first. You break the features them into requirements, sequenced plans and tickets that hold up under pressure. Day to day you're working with engineers, QA and business stakeholders, keeping projects moving and expectations honest.
There's room to grow. The product practice is still being built out, so discovery, PRDs, retrospectives and data informed prioritization are all things you'll be exposed to and can grow into over time.
Your first 6 months

• You own a portfolio of live projects end to end, from requirements through release, and everyone always knows where each one stands.

• Messy, multi part initiatives arrive from marketing, ops and customer experience, and you turn them into plans people can execute against.

• Your specs and acceptance criteria cut rework, with QA looped in early instead of at the end.

• You know the e-commerce stack, subscription flows and customer journeys well enough that engineers and stakeholders come to you first.

• You're contributing to sprint process, retros and planning cadence as the practice matures.

Who we're looking for

• 2-4 years in product management or technical project management. E-commerce or consumer products is a plus.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You write clear tickets, requirements and status updates, and you keep a distributed team aligned without endless back and forth.

• You chase ambiguity down rather than waiting on it, and you flag risk before it turns into a delay.

• Comfortable in Jira and Figma, at home with analytics tools. Shopify or other subscription commerce platforms a plus.

• Someone the team wants to work with. Much of this job is sitting between engineers and stakeholders, so being easy to collaborate with matters as much as process skill.

• Keen to grow as a PM, with mentorship and increasing ownership over time.

Engagement
Full time, remote, long term contract. Candidates based in South America with substantial overlap with US business hours.

title: Senior Project Manager - Cloud
description:

• Ensure service delivery success, quality, and customer satisfaction through effective project and program management practices.

• Lead project initiation activities, including confirmation of client objectives, success metrics, scope, assumptions, constraints, dependencies, and governance model .

• Develop, maintain, and execute project plans, schedules, budgets, work breakdown structures, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs .

• Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned projects, driving clear and proactive communication with client stakeholders and internal leadership.

• Facilitate status meetings, steering committees, and executive-level updates , providing transparent views of progress, risks, decisions, and financial health.

• Align delivery with AIC and client standards (e.g., Agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery), ensuring the ways-of-working are explicit and followed.

• Partner with Engagement Leads and Client Directors to shape a top-notch client experience , including responsiveness, expectation management, and structured escalation handling.
3. Coordination of Global & After-Hours Work

• Oversee and coordinate after-hours and weekend change windows (e.g., production cutovers, platform migrations, major releases) in partnership with US-based PMs and TLs.

• Model and reinforce AIC PMO standards for project hygiene, governance, and reporting, including use of standard templates, dashboards, and inspection routines.

• Contribute to practice development , including harvesting reusable artifacts (plans, RAID logs, status report templates, change playbooks) and improving delivery frameworks.

• Provide coaching and mentoring to junior project managers, coordinators, and consultants who are performing PM tasks on AIC engagements.

• Collaborate with Resource Management and Delivery leaders regarding resource planning and capacity management , helping to structure onshore/offshore staffing models that align to AIC scoping guidelines.
6. Pre-Sales & Opportunity Support (As Needed)

title: Inpatient Coder (CCS / CIC)
description:
Role Title: Inpatient Coder (ICD-10 / CCS / CIC)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Inpatient Coders (ICD-10 / CCS / CIC certified) to contribute their expertise to a dynamic project for a valued customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Annotate and review inpatient medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, operative reports, consults, lab and imaging results, and discharge summaries, ensuring precise ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS code assignment based on documentation.

• Identify principal and secondary diagnoses, sequence codes according to guidelines, assign Present on Admission (POA) indicators, and validate MS-DRG assignment, including the identification of CCs and MCCs, to verify and enrich data sets.

• Apply inpatient-specific coding conventions, such as UHDDS definitions, ICD-10-CM/PCS Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, and AHA Coding Clinic guidance, while identifying hospital-acquired conditions (HACs) and patient safety indicators.

• Collaborate with project stakeholders using both written and verbal communication to clarify requirements, resolve documentation ambiguities, and ensure data integrity.

• Deliver high-quality feedback on coding guidelines and complex cases to support project workflow improvements and enhance AI model understanding.

• Ensure accuracy and completeness of all coding-related annotations per current best practices and coding standards.

Preferred Qualifications

• Active AHIMA Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) or AAPC Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) credential.

• Thorough expertise in ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and MS-DRG methodology with hands-on inpatient coding experience.

• Experience coding in diverse inpatient settings, such as acute care, teaching hospitals, specialty units, surgical, trauma, oncology, cardiology, and transplant cases.

• Proficiency in reviewing and coding various types of clinical documentation and addressing complex coding challenges.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating meticulous attention to detail and clarity.

• Access to current ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS code sets, Official Coding Guidelines, and MS-DRG grouper tools.

- Knowledge of open banking, including UK Open Banking, PSD2/PSD3, AIS/PIS, and VRP.

- Domain depth in payments, identity verification, or credit and underwriting.

- Experience with mobile integrations.

- Fluency in a second European language.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Test Automation Engineer
Location : 100% Remote (U.S.)

Experience Required : 6+ years

Sponsorship : U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to bring strong software engineering practices to the discipline of test automation. In this role you will design, build, and continuously improve automation frameworks, write production-quality test code, and partner with development teams to embed quality engineering throughout the SDLC. The ideal candidate will combine strong programming skills with deep knowledge of testing strategy, including unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security testing in modern distributed systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and build robust, scalable test automation frameworks for web, API, mobile, and microservice testing.

• Write production-quality automated test code in Java, Python, JavaScript, or C# using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or Pact.

• Implement contract testing using Pact or similar tools to validate service contracts in microservice ecosystems.

• Build comprehensive CI/CD test pipelines integrated with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.

• Develop performance test suites using JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust, including realistic load models and result analysis.

• Implement security testing fundamentals including dependency scanning, SAST, DAST, and OWASP-based checks.

• Lead test strategy discussions, including risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and shift-left practices.

• Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and architects to identify quality risks early.

• Perform root-cause analysis of production incidents, and translate findings into automated regression tests.

• Drive continuous improvement of test coverage, test reliability, and time-to-feedback.

• Mentor junior QA engineers and uphold engineering rigor in the testing community.

• Maintain comprehensive test documentation, traceability, and reporting dashboards, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

• Contribute to internal testing tools and reusable libraries, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of experience as an SDET or in test-focused software engineering roles.

• Strong programming skills in at least one of Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major UI automation framework (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).

• Solid experience automating REST and/or gR

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. The Team:

Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. • Manage challenging conversations while maintaining professional relationships.

• Identify operational issues, investigate discrepancies, and recommend practical solutions.

• Provide clear updates and reports on case progress, research outcomes, and outstanding actions.

Minimum Requirements

• Relevant experience in commercial collections, debt recovery, payment negotiations, investigative research, or financial operations.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong investigative research and analytical abilities.

• Ability to identify relevant business relationships and potential third-party payment obligations.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej organizacji notowanej na NASDAQ w Sztokholmie, działającej w 11 krajach. W Polsce mamy pełną autonomię. Sami wybieramy technologie, procesy i sposób pracy, zachowując najwyższe standardy.
Realizujemy różnorodne projekty IT w Polsce i globalnie, w wielu obszarach i technologiach, co pozwala rozwijać kompetencje i zdobywać doświadczenie dopasowane do Twoich ambicji.
Naszą współpracę opieramy na filozofii CARE. Rozumiemy ją jako odpowiedzialny dobór projektów, transparentną współpracę oraz długofalowe podejście do rozwoju.
Dołącz do nas jako Forward Deployed Engineer i rozwijaj się w środowisku, które myśli o Twoim rozwoju tak samo, jak Ty.
Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) prowadzą złożone, kompleksowe wdrożenia modeli generatywnych (frontier models) w środowisku produkcyjnym, razem z naszymi najważniejszymi klientami. Odpowiadasz za cały proces: discovery, zakres techniczny, projekt systemu, budowę i wdrożenie produkcyjne. Pracujesz bezpośrednio z zespołami inżynierskimi i domenowymi klienta.
Sukces mierzymy adopcją na produkcji, wymiernym wpływem na procesy pracy oraz feedbackiem opartym na ewaluacji (eval-driven), który realnie zmienia roadmapy produktu i modeli.
Twoje zadania:

• Odpowiadać za dostarczenie technicznej części wielu wdrożeń, od pierwszego prototypu po stabilną produkcję.

• Budować systemy full-stack, które dają klientowi realną wartość i pomagają nam szybciej się uczyć.

• Pracować blisko zespołów klienta, rozumieć ich potrzeby i prowadzić ich przez adopcję rozwiązania.

• Definiować zakres prac, planować kolejność dostaw i wcześnie usuwać blokery.

• Podejmować decyzje w trójkącie zakres, tempo, jakość oraz korygować plan tak, by zabezpieczyć dostawę.

• Pisać kod samodzielnie, gdy od tego zależy postęp lub klarowność.

• Przekształcać sprawdzone sposoby pracy w narzędzia, playbooki i gotowe klocki dla innych.

• Przekazywać feedback z pola zespołom Research i Product: gdzie modele sprawdzają się dobrze, a gdzie można je poprawić.

• Dbać o płynność pracy zespołów przez jasną komunikację i konsekwencję w działaniu.

Dobrze się u nas odnajdziesz, jeśli:

• Masz 5+ lat doświadczenia w inżynierii lub wdrożeniach technicznych, z elementem pracy z klientem.

• Planowałeś/-aś i dowoziłeś/-aś złożone systemy w dynamicznym, niejednoznacznym środowisku.

• Piszesz i recenzujesz kod produkcyjny we frontendzie i backendzie (Python, JavaScript lub podobne stosy).

• Budowałeś/-aś lub wdrażałeś/-aś systemy oparte na LLM-ach lub modelach generatywnych i rozumiesz, jak zachowanie modelu wpływa na doświadczenie użytkownika.

• Upraszczasz złożone problemy i szybko podejmujesz trafne decyzje pod presją.

• Komunikujesz się jasno z inżynierami, zespołami produktowymi i interesariuszami klienta.

• Wcześnie dostrzegasz ryzyka i reagujesz bez spowalniania zespołu.

• Musisz mieszkać i/lub posiadać uprawnienia do pracy w Polsce.

• Masz poziom języka polskiego minimum B2, a angielskiego B2+/C1.

Co oferujemy?

• Współpracę projektową lub zadaniową, w elastycznym wymiarze godzin.

• Współpracę w skandynawskiej kulturze opartej o logikę i dialog.

• Treningi sportowe, wewnętrzna drużyna, wspólne zawody.

• Imprezy integracyjne i spotkania rozwojowe.

title: Business Development Manager – Food & Beverage
description:
This role is for a position at WISEcode labs, WISEcode's sister company and an independent third party testing lab. 
--
WISEcode Labs, formerly Beaconpoint Labs, was built out of necessity.
The laboratory was created to support its sister company WISEcode and its Food Genome Project™, an ambitious effort to build a comprehensive food and ingredient intelligence platform. In pursuing that goal, it became clear that the required testing capabilities simply did not exist. No laboratory could reliably deliver the breadth, depth, speed, and transparency needed to analyze thousands of ingredients across hundreds of analytes with confidence. Rather than compromise, the lab was built to solve that problem properly.
WISEcode Labs is an independent third-party testing laboratory serving food, beverage, dietary supplement, ingredient, and adjacent consumer-health companies. The lab combines advanced analytical instrumentation, rigorous method development, microbiology and chemistry expertise, and a high-touch service model designed for customers with complex and recurring testing needs.
WISEcode Labs is differentiated by its unwavering focus on food safety and nutrition testing and becoming a primary testing partner to key customers, owing to its rapid response time and direct access to scientific leaders, customized solutions, and defensible data.
Effective August 25th 2026, the company unified its brand with its sister company under a single name: WISEcode Labs. The next phase is to scale this platform without losing the quality, speed, independence, confidentiality, and accountability on which the business was built to be the preferred testing & scientific partner for the food industry and WISEcode’s mission towards food transparency.

title: Data Scientist, Personalization & Machine Learning
description:
About the Team

We work across product, growth, and monetization to help people get more value from OpenAI’s products. We identify opportunities for machine learning, build and test early solutions, and partner with engineering and product to bring successful approaches into production.

About the Role

We’re looking for a data scientist who can enter an unfamiliar product area, find a useful ML application, and turn it into a working product intervention. You will own the work from problem definition and data preparation through modeling, experimentation, and launch evaluation.

Projects will include personalization, next-best-action recommendations, lifecycle management, promotion targeting, and models of retention and customer lifetime value. You will help identify opportunities, build proofs of concept, evaluate, and iterate.

In this role, you will:

- Partner with engineers on integration, serving or batch scoring, monitoring, and rollout. Stay involved through launch and iteration.

- Explain results and limitations clearly, document decisions, and build reusable methods that other teams can adopt.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have built and evaluated applied ML systems that influenced a product or business decision, with clear ownership of the modeling work.

- Write effective Python and SQL and can investigate imperfect data, debug models, and make pragmatic implementation choices. 

- Build and schedule production scoring pipelines using dbt, airflow, and flyte.

- Understand supervised learning, evaluation, experimentation, and the difference between predicting an outcome and changing it.

- Can scope ambiguous problems, work across disciplines, and explain technical tradeoffs to colleagues with different backgrounds.

- Are motivated by helping people use AI effectively and by learning unfamiliar product domains.

- Are excited to take on challenging, impactful ML problems across multiple areas.

- Have experience with recommendation systems, personalization, growth, retention, lifetime value, or treatment-effect modeling would be useful. We welcome candidates whose relevant experience comes from other domains.

The Director, Vendor Management leads the end-to-end vendor strategy and day-to-day management of the supplier base powering a national 6,000-store remodel program. This is a high-volume, high-velocity role accountable for onboarding, contracting, performance, and cost control across hundreds of vendors - general contractors, fixture and millwork suppliers, signage, lighting, flooring, HVAC/MEP trades, logistics, and specialty installers - delivering remodels at a sustained pace of dozens of stores per week.
The Director owns the data backbone of the program. This is a heavily analytical, Excel-intensive position: the successful candidate builds and maintains the vendor scorecards, cost models, capacity plans, and rollout trackers that keep thousands of concurrent work orders on schedule and on budget. They translate a sprawling vendor landscape into a controlled, measurable, repeatable machine.
Key Responsibilities
Vendor Strategy & Portfolio Management
• Own the overall vendor management strategy for the remodel program, segmenting the supplier base by trade, region, spend, criticality, and risk.

• Build dynamic dashboards and trackers (pivot tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, complex nested logic, what-if scenario modeling) to manage thousands of concurrent work orders.
• Consolidate disparate vendor, cost, and schedule data into a single source of truth; produce executive-ready reporting on spending, performance, and program health.
• Run cost variance, budget-vs-actual, and savings-tracking analyses; identify and quantify cost-reduction and consolidation opportunities.
• Partner with PMO/IT to graduate critical models into scalable systems (e.g., procurement/PM platforms, BI tools) as the program matures.
Performance, Compliance & Risk
• Define and govern vendor KPIs and SLAs; run regular business reviews (QBRs) and performance scorecarding across the supplier base.
• Ensure vendor compliance with contractual, insurance, safety, licensing, and regulatory requirements across all jurisdictions.
• Proactively manage supply, capacity, and single-source risk; build contingency and backup-vendor plans to protect the schedule.

title: Virtual Executive Medical Assistant & Scribe

In this dual-function role, you will manage real-time medical scribing and chart documentation for 18-25 patients daily, while taking complete ownership of executive administrative tasks, personal support, and practice coordination during non-patient hours.
The ideal candidate possesses strong medical terminology and clinical literacy (an RN license is not required, but solid scribing/clinical workflow experience is essential). You must be comfortable navigating AdvancedMD EMR , managing phone/VoIP systems for patient follow-ups, and operating with high autonomy to streamline Dr. Gifford's daily schedule, documentation, and administrative workload.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

•
Role Title: Executive Medical Assistant & Virtual Scribe

•
Provider: Dr. Gifford (Solo Practitioner)

•
Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week - Compressed 4-Day Work Week)

•
Schedule: Tuesday - Friday, 8:30 AM - 6:30 PM CST (10 Hours / Day)

•
Core Technology Stack: AdvancedMD EMR , VoIP Telephone Systems (UMA / prospective platform upgrade), Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

•
Patient Volume: 18-25 patients per day

Top 3 Daily Tasks

•
Medical Scribing & Real-Time Documentation: Scribe patient encounters in real time, accurately capturing histories, physical exams, assessment plans, and clinical notes within AdvancedMD EMR.

•
Provider Documentation & Executive Support: Utilize non-patient time to organize, complete, and audit Dr. Gifford’s administrative notes, paperwork, correspondence, and practice task queues.

•
Patient Follow-Ups & Scheduling: Conduct inbound/outbound calls to follow up with patients, coordinate appointments, and communicate provider instructions clearly.

Core Responsibilities

•
Real-Time Virtual Scribing: Document patient encounters live or asynchronously, translating clinical conversations into structured SOAP notes and EHR chart updates in AdvancedMD without altering medical intent.

•
Executive & Administrative Assistance: Act as Dr. Gifford's central administrative control point-managing calendars, organizing daily priorities, drafting correspondence, and taking ownership of special projects to eliminate decision fatigue.

•
Patient Care Coordination: Perform outbound calls for post-visit follow-ups, deliver non-clinical doctor instructions, schedule follow-up appointments, and manage patient inquiries via VoIP (UMA).

•
Chart Preparation & File Audit: Prepare patient charts prior to appointments, verify that incoming diagnostic reports/labs are attached to the correct patient records in AdvancedMD, and track pending chart completions.

•
Practice Workflow Oversight: Serve as a reliable second set of eyes on practice communication, ensuring no patient messages, provider tasks, or administrative requests slip through the cracks.

Requirements

Medical Scribing & Terminology Literacy: Direct experience as a Medical Scribe or Clinical Assistant, with strong command of U.S. medical terminology, anatomy, and SOAP note formatting. (RN/Nursing degree is NOT required).

•
EHR/EMR Proficiency: Direct, hands-on experience navigating AdvancedMD EMR or similar complex EHR software platforms.

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken - you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our Fraud Prevention Specialist, you'll protect Satispay’s users and assets by mastering fraud detection and prevention across Cards, SEPA Direct Debit (SDD), and other payment schemes, keeping financial and reputational losses to a minimum while preserving a seamless user experience. Here's what that looks like in practice:

- UX & Friction Calibration - Partner with Product teams to ensure fraud controls and step-up authentication methods strike the right balance between risk mitigation and a smooth user journey.

- Data Collection & Insights Sharing - Gather, structure, and synthesise fraud loss and transaction data to generate actionable insights and performance metrics for cross-functional stakeholders.

- Incident Escalation & Forensic Triage - Conduct deep-dive triage on complex card/SDD fraud schemes and escalate critical vectors or systematic exploits for rapid remediation.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone operationally sharp and data-minded who understands digital payment mechanics and brings high vigilance to protecting customer accounts and assets.

- Experience - 2 to 4 years in fraud operations or transaction monitoring within fintech, digital banking, or payment processing ecosystems.

- Payment Scheme Expertise - Solid understanding of payment mechanics, specifically Card processing flows, SEPA Direct Debit (SDD) return cycles, and velocity/pattern monitoring techniques.

- Rule Design & Data Literacy - Proficiency in querying transactional datasets and spotting anomalies using analytics tools (such as Looker, HEX, or SQL) to shape logic for automated detection scenarios.

- Recovery & Loss Management - Familiarity with negative balance recovery management, chargeback operational handling, or structured debt collection workflows.

- UX & Risk Balance - Product-sensitive approach to applying fraud controls without introducing unnecessary user friction.

title: Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
description:
The role

As an Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development , you will be a senior member of a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO .

This role balances corporate development / M&A with corporate strategy. You lead projects across both areas as the day-to-day owner and guide a small number of more junior colleagues and internal functional experts. You operate with minimal direction and take projects from a vague problem statement to a CEO-ready recommendation. You also stay hands-on , personally building the models and analysis and preparing the executive-level outputs that drive investment and strategy decisions.

What you’ll do

• M&A Strategy: Lead M&A projects end to end (owning small and mid-sized transactions independently and partnering with the Director on the largest, transformational deals), from target screening and valuation through due diligence, negotiation preparation, and post-deal integration. Run deal teams day to day, coordinate external advisors and act as the lead with target management teams or their advisors. You are not just a process manager but can form and defend a point of view on whether and why a deal makes strategic sense and present it directly to senior leadership.

• Portfolio Optimization: Lead the strategic analysis and recommendations for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.

• Corporate Strategy : Contribute to the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, owning the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.

• Capital Allocation: Own and develop analytical frameworks and models to support strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.

• Business Unit Strategy: Act as a senior internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.

What you’ll bring

• Experience: 6+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team. This includes leading projects or deal teams with minimal supervision.

• Process and deal leadership: You have led complex, multi-stakeholder processes to a deadline, coordinating internal functions and external advisors and managing senior counterparties such as target or client management teams. This can come from running M&A transactions (in-house corporate development or advisory) or from leading strategy projects with transaction exposure, such as due diligence, carve-outs, partnerships or market entries. Direct M&A process experience is a strong plus; the ability to learn it quickly is essential.

• Leadership and Influence: You have guided and developed more junior colleagues and influenced senior stakeholders, including through negotiation and building rapport with counterparties.

• Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You structure ambiguous problems and set direction for others, not just solve them yourself. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.

• Financial Acumen: Expert-level financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended complex models used for high-stakes investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.
